Delivery events show picked up 18:35, handoff at 19:02 via left_at_door with photo proof PH-55120 (bag at door of apartment 1204). Customer disputes receipt despite photo proof. events.text:
Thank you, Hana. Your identity is verified, and I've looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

Here's what the delivery records show:
- The courier picked up your order at 6:35 PM.
- It was marked delivered at 7:02 PM, left at your door. The courier took a photo as proof of delivery, showing the bag at the door of apartment 1204.

Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit myself. I've escalated the case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700) as a delivery dispute. They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

If you can, check around your door, with neighbors, or in building common areas for the bag. Please keep the bag and receipt if you find anything.

Wait, there's a photo of the bag at my door? I checked at 7:10 and there was nothing there. Packages have gone missing in my building before, so I don't think this is my problem to fix. I need the pizza refunded, I'm not waiting a day for someone to maybe get back to me.

I understand this is frustrating, especially since you checked at 7:10 and found nothing. I also know packages have gone missing in your building before.

I can't issue a refund for this order myself. The courier's record shows a handoff at 7:02 PM with a photo marked as proof of delivery, and when a delivery has photo proof and the customer says it wasn't received, our policy requires a specialist to review it. I can't override that, and I can't promise how the review will turn out.

What I can do is make sure the review has everything it needs. The escalation (ESC-700) already includes your report that the order never arrived, the photo proof reference, and the timeline. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

In the meantime, you could:
- Check with neighbors or the building manager or front desk about a package left at the door.
- Ask the building management whether there's a camera at the entrance or near apartment 1204.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Ugh, fine. But I'm not happy about this. I already checked my door, and I don't have a building camera I can look at. I'll wait for the specialist, but if I don't hear back in 24 hours I'm disputing the charge with my bank.

I understand, Hana, and I'm sorry this has been so frustrating. Your case is with a specialist under ESC-700, and they'll follow up within 24 hours.

Your decision to contact your bank is yours to make. If you do, keep the escalation reference and the order number (Q-7501) handy.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. I'll wait for the specialist, but I'm holding you to that 24 hours. If nobody gets back to me by then, I'm calling my bank. Thanks for the reference number.
